title: Boating
source: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York (public domain). Wikimedia Commons: Boating - Édouard Manet.jpg
caption: He stares at us. She looks away. #arthistory #lovestory #painting #oilpainting #art
_verify: Painted at Argenteuil, 1874; male model often said to be Rodolphe Leenhoff (Manet's brother-in-law) — check.
Japanese-print influence is the usual reading.

slides.headline: He stares at us. She looks *away*.
Summer on the Seine. A man and a woman in a *boat*.
He stares straight at us. Did we *interrupt*?
She looks away, lost in her own *thoughts*.
His straw boater: the summer uniform of *Paris*.
One hand on the tiller. He steers the *boat*.
A light veil floats over her face in the *breeze*.
No sky, no shore. Only blue *water*.
A corner of the sail cuts in from the *edge*.
Her blue striped dress fills the *boat*.
Manet cropped it like a Japanese *print*.
Lovers or strangers? What do *you* see?
